**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept traditional spellings of the one-time payment suffix**

Fresh evidence beyond the repaired simplified `一并支付` continuation is that `4000元一並支付`, `4000元一併支付`, and their `給付`/`發放` variants still normalize as `unsupported`, while `4000元一并支付` remains exact. Because the numeral-leading suffix is treated as a truncated amount unless this exception matches, add the traditional `並/併` spellings to the bounded payment-instruction grammar.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
